values.note: Double sites (up to 16 people, 4 vehicles) are $72 on recreation.gov. The forest page still posts $35 single / $60 double. Day-use parking inside the campground is $10.

note: On Highway 33 eight miles north of Ojai, shaded by oak and sycamore; paved spurs. More than half the sites cap at 15-22 ft, so check the site's own length. A seasonal creek runs through the middle of the campground in winter and spring and is dry in summer. Run by a concessionaire. --Claude
summary: Wheeler Gorge: year-round, rec.gov $37 (stored 35; FS page still $35), 69 sites, RV 35 ft but only 30 of 66 catalog units take 24 ft+, 59 reservable/9 FCFS, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums, no water. Creekside -> not waterfront recommended (FS: creek 'Dry during summer months', under canopy). Pin ~270 m -> centroid.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'creekside' (not --AWH) -> recommend 'not waterfront'. The FS page says 'Creek runs through campground seasonally in the winter and spring. Dry during summer months.' Imagery shows only oak/sycamore canopy (no water); a 3DEP transect puts the drainage through the middle of the campground at sites 035 (34.51403,-119.27336), 036 (34.51445,-119.27298) and 018 (34.51432,-119.27240), the sites old camper reviews named. If the reviewer accepts a seasonal creek, those are the sites (035/036 are 20 ft on rec.gov; 018 is 40 ft) - but a stream that is dry through the main camping season does not earn the value under default-down.

PIN: stored 34.51140,-119.27400 sits at the south end by the entrance (the FS point 34.5117,-119.2739); catalog site centroid 34.51371,-119.27313 is ~270 m north - move. Sites run from 34.5115 to 34.5156 along the west side of Highway 33.
FIT: 36 of 66 catalog units cap at 15-22 ft (RV and trailer the same); 30 take 24 ft+ (24-30 ft at most of them; 018 40 ft, 047 and 061 45 ft). In the note.
FEES: rec.gov $37 single / $72 double (2026 and 2027) vs the FS page's $35 / $60 - wrote rec.gov.
BOOKING: FS 'at least 3 days in advance' vs rec.gov reservationCutOff 1 - both in booking.note; reserve_until left unset.

OPERATOR / PHONE: concession Camp Los Padres (rec.gov: 820-500-1099, info@camplospadres.com); stored 805-646-4348 is the Ojai Ranger District number the FS page gives - keep, or change to the concession's 820-500-1099 if the reviewer prefers the campground's own line. rec.gov 'Contact Info' also says '(820) 500-1099'.
